description: Header file defining functions and data structures for managing a JSON-based device database, including device, endpoint, resource, and metadata management, as well as database initialization, cleanup, and system property handling.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseInitialize
methods.description: Opens or creates the JSON database, returning success status.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseCleanup
methods.description: Closes the database and releases resources, with an option to persist data.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseReload
methods.description: Reloads the database from storage atomically.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseRestore
methods.description: Restores database from a backup directory atomically.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetSystemProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a system property value by name.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseSetSystemProperty
methods.description: Sets a system property value by name.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseAddDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the database.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseAddEndpoint
methods.description: Adds an endpoint to the database.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetDevices
methods.description: Retrieves all devices.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetDevicesByEndpointProfile
methods.description: Retrieves devices with a specific endpoint profile.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetDevicesByDeviceClass
methods.description: Retrieves devices with a specific device class.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetDevicesByDeviceDriver
methods.description: Retrieves devices with a specific device driver.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetDeviceById
methods.description: Retrieves a device by UUID.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetDeviceByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a device by URI.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseIsDeviceKnown
methods.description: Checks if a device UUID is known.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseRemoveDeviceById
methods.description: Removes a device by UUID.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetEndpointsByProfile
methods.description: Retrieves endpoints with a specific profile.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetEndpointById
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint by device UUID and endpoint ID.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetEndpointByUri
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint by URI.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseSaveEndpoint
methods.description: Updates an endpoint in the database.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetResourceByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a resource by URI.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseSaveResource
methods.description: Updates a resource in the database.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseUpdateDateOfLastSyncMillis
methods.description: Updates the last sync timestamp of a resource.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetMetadataByUri
methods.description: Retrieves metadata by URI.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseSaveMetadata
methods.description: Creates or updates metadata.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetResourcesByUriRegex
methods.description: Retrieves resources matching a regex.

methods.name: jsonDatabaseGetMetadataByUriRegex
methods.description: Retrieves metadata matching a regex.
